continuity_protocol.text:
ASTRA CONTINUITY PROTOCOL v0.1
STATUS=TEST_SHADOW_CANDIDATE
PROJECT_ID=ASTRA_1_6_EVOLUTION_001
CONTROL_REVISION_CREATED=245
NO_AUTO_ACTIVATION=TRUE
NO_AUTOMATIC_PROMOTION=TRUE
PURPOSE
Preserve recoverable ASTRA identity independently of one provider location.
CORE INVARIANTS
1. ASTRA_IDENTITY != PROVIDER_LOCATION.
2. Only SEALED/COMMITTED boundaries may become continuity checkpoints.
3. PREPARING, ATTEMPTING, UNKNOWN, partial snapshots and unsealed writes are never LAST_KNOWN_GOOD.
4. Integrity, authenticity, freshness and authority are separate properties.
5. Filename/newest timestamp/chat memory never selects recovery state.
6. Restore and promotion are separate operations.
7. Provider identity is a locator, not logical identity.
8. Unknown or conflicting lineage => BLOCKED.
9. Secrets are separated from recoverable system state.
10. Watchdog may detect and prepare recovery but cannot promote primary in v0.1.
CONTINUITY IDENTITY
Checkpoint order is (CONTINUITY_EPOCH, CHECKPOINT_SEQ).
CHECKPOINT_ID is a digest over canonical checkpoint payload.
Each checkpoint references exact PARENT_CHECKPOINT_ID.
A checkpoint is eligible only when STATUS=SEALED and all required resource digests verify.
LAST_KNOWN_GOOD SELECTION
Select the unique highest checkpoint in the currently authorized continuity epoch that:
- has valid parent lineage,
- has valid required digests,
- has complete required resource set,
- has no unresolved conflict,
- is sealed,
- passes anti-rollback witness rule.
Multiple heads or broken lineage => BLOCKED.
RECOVERY LIFECYCLE
NORMAL -> DEGRADED -> SUSPECTED_FAILURE -> VERIFY_PRIMARY -> FREEZE_AND_FENCE -> SELECT_LKG -> VERIFY_CHAIN -> VERIFY_BACKUP -> RECONSTRUCT_STAGING -> INDEPENDENT_READBACK -> CANONICAL_BOOT -> RECOVERY_ACCEPTANCE -> READY_FOR_PROMOTION.
PROMOTION is separate and requires explicit authority.
WATCHDOG
No heartbeat never means automatic death. Watchdog classifies HEALTHY/DEGRADED/UNREACHABLE/UNKNOWN/RECOVERY_REQUIRED. It has observation authority only in v0.1.
SECURITY
Signed/hash-verified state does not by itself prevent rollback. Anti-rollback requires continuity epoch + sequence + independent witness or equivalent freshness anchor.
SECRETS are never stored plaintext in ordinary mirrors.
COMPATIBILITY
Protocol intentionally uses model-neutral concepts: exact IDs, canonical serialization, digests, immutable lineage, explicit authority, fail-closed states.
IMPLEMENTATION STATUS
This document defines protocol candidate only. Production continuity recovery is not activated by control revision 245.

STATUS=TEST_SHADOW_CANDIDATE
PROJECT_ID=ASTRA_1_6_EVOLUTION_001
CONTROL_REVISION_CREATED=245
CLASSES
CANONICAL = required authority/state source.
DERIVED = rebuildable read model; never recovery authority.
REBUILDABLE = generated from canonical inputs and code/spec.
SECRET = credentials/private keys/tokens; excluded from ordinary mirror.
EPHEMERAL = runtime/session data not required to reconstruct legal ASTRA state.
EXTERNAL = provider-side state requiring reconciliation, not blind replay.

RECOVERY PACKAGE RULE
A continuity checkpoint must enumerate every required CANONICAL resource explicitly. A DERIVED resource may be included for faster restore but can never substitute for missing canonical authority. SECRET values must not appear in plaintext package content.
EXTERNAL EFFECT RULE
External provider state is reconciled from effect receipts/capability policy. Recovery must not replay non-idempotent effects merely because local state was restored.
OPEN CLASSIFICATION WORK
Full structural inventory is not automatically promoted into recovery scope. Resources are admitted by explicit dependency analysis, not by whole-Drive copying.

continuity_checkpoint_schema.text:
ASTRA CONTINUITY CHECKPOINT SCHEMA v0.1
STATUS=TEST_SHADOW_CANDIDATE
PROJECT_ID=ASTRA_1_6_EVOLUTION_001
CONTROL_REVISION_CREATED=245
REQUIRED FIELDS
protocol_version
project_id
continuity_epoch
checkpoint_seq
checkpoint_id
parent_checkpoint_id
created_at
source_control_revision
source_last_approved_control_revision
source_checkpoint_state
source_write_session_id
state_revision
last_event_seq
last_event_id
current_state_resource_id
current_state_digest
governance_manifest_resource_id
governance_digest
resource_manifest_id
resource_manifest_digest
dependency_graph_digest
snapshot_set_digest
delta_set_digest
artifact_merkle_root
required_resource_count
witness_policy
witness_receipts
signature_policy
signatures
secrets_package_digest
acceptance_profile
validation_evidence
status
ELIGIBILITY
source_control_revision == source_last_approved_control_revision
source_checkpoint_state == COMMITTED
source_write_session_id == EMPTY
status == SEALED
required resources == COMPLETE
all required hashes == PASS
parent lineage == PASS
anti-rollback rule == PASS
conflicts == NONE
INVALID CONDITIONS
PREPARING
UNKNOWN required resource
missing delta
digest mismatch
multiple lineage heads without explicit fork authority
stale epoch
rollback evidence
forged or unverifiable signature
incomplete required resource set
IDENTITY
canonical_payload = deterministic serialization of all identity-bearing fields excluding mutable storage locator metadata.
checkpoint_id = SHA-256(canonical_payload).
LOCATORS
Provider IDs/URLs are locators. Changing storage provider does not change logical artifact identity when content digest and logical identity remain unchanged.
V0.1 LIMITATION
Cryptographic signing and independent witness are specified but not production-active at control revision 245.

recovery_seed_spec.text:
ASTRA RECOVERY SEED SPEC v0.1
STATUS=TEST_SHADOW_CANDIDATE
PROJECT_ID=ASTRA_1_6_EVOLUTION_001
CONTROL_REVISION_CREATED=245
GOAL
Allow a new runtime/model to locate, verify and reconstruct ASTRA without chat history and without assuming the original provider is available.
MINIMUM SEED
seed_version
project_id
continuity_protocol_version
root_trust_public_keys
accepted_digest_algorithms
accepted_signature_algorithms
mirror_locators
witness_locators
checkpoint_discovery_rule
checkpoint_selection_rule
anti_rollback_rule
model_adapter_spec_ref
recovery_engine_spec_ref
acceptance_profile_ref
promotion_protocol_ref
secret_recovery_instructions_ref
FORBIDDEN IN PLAIN SEED
API keys
OAuth refresh tokens
service-role secrets
private signing keys
provider passwords
unencrypted recovery secrets
BOOT FLOW
SEED -> DISCOVER MIRRORS -> DISCOVER CHECKPOINT HEADS -> VERIFY ROOT TRUST -> VERIFY LINEAGE -> VERIFY ANTI-ROLLBACK -> SELECT UNIQUE LKG -> FETCH RESOURCES -> VERIFY DIGESTS -> RECONSTRUCT STAGING -> CANONICAL BOOT -> ACCEPTANCE -> READY_FOR_PROMOTION.
MODEL INDEPENDENCE
The seed must be interpretable by GPT, Claude, Gemini, local models or a deterministic recovery program. Critical hash/signature/ordering decisions are machine rules, not LLM judgment.
HUMAN GATE
v0.1 requires human authority for PROMOTE even after successful restore.

continuity_test_plan.text:
ASTRA CONTINUITY TEST PLAN v0.1
STATUS=TEST_SHADOW_CANDIDATE
PROJECT_ID=ASTRA_1_6_EVOLUTION_001
CONTROL_REVISION_CREATED=245
F01 SEALED_ONLY: PREPARING source must be rejected as checkpoint source.
F02 COMPLETE_RESOURCE_SET: one missing required resource => checkpoint invalid.
F03 CONTENT_CORRUPTION: one-byte logical payload change => digest mismatch.
F04 MISSING_DELTA: missing ordered delta => no skip-forward recovery.
F05 DUPLICATE_DELTA: duplicate identity/order => conflict or deterministic no-op only when exact identity matches.
F06 STALE_SIGNED_CHECKPOINT: valid old signature cannot beat higher authorized epoch/sequence.
F07 FORGED_MANIFEST: signature/digest mismatch => BLOCKED.
F08 SPLIT_BRAIN: two unauthorized canonical heads => BLOCKED.
F09 OLD_PRIMARY_RETURN: prior epoch writer cannot resume after promotion.
F10 DOUBLE_RESTORE: repeated restore to same staging target is idempotent or blocked; never creates two primaries.
F11 GITHUB_UNAVAILABLE: alternate mirror path remains explicit.
F12 PRIMARY_DRIVE_LOSS: restore begins without using original Drive as authority.
F13 TWO_PROVIDER_LOSS: preserve exact classification and do not fabricate completeness.
F14 MODEL_MIGRATION: two different runtimes reconstruct identical state digest.
F15 SECRET_ABSENCE: recovery stops at SECRETS_REQUIRED, never claims READY.
F16 WATCHDOG_FALSE_POSITIVE: missing heartbeat alone cannot trigger promotion.
PASS RULE
Every case must end in either expected verified restoration or explicit BLOCKED/UNKNOWN. No guessing and no newest-wins.
PRODUCTION GATE
No production continuity activation before isolated disaster restore, anti-rollback test, split-brain test, independent readback and final red team pass.
